title: Multilingual Resources for Migrant Workers NSW - Access to support services
topic: support/referral organisation; access to support services
content: Source PDF filename: rmwc_workplace_rights_vi.pdf; source PDF pages: 1-3 and 9-10.
RMWC states that its multilingual education program helps migrant workers access support services and understand workplace rights.
The document provides a general resources pathway including Legal Help, Multilingual resources, Make an enquiry, Request a session and Get in touch.
The document lists the public contact number 1300 513 107 and email hello@migrants.org.au; these are reproduced as source contact details, not legal advice.
Publication date is not stated in the PDF; access date is 13 September 2026.
